history.summary: Kachahari Durga Mandir near Gandhi Maidan on Main Mahadeva Road, in the Amlori locality of Siwan (Bihar 841226), is the most-documented 'Durga Mandir' in Siwan city (Justdial 4.5/312). No founding date, dynasty, or founder is documented in any source consulted; it is a popular neighbourhood shrine. Other Durga temples exist in Siwan (Fatehpur, Shanti Nagar, Makhdum Sarai), so the CSV's generic 'Durga Mandir' is matched to this listing with that ambiguity flagged.

name: Kachahari Durga Mandir
town_description: Siwan is the district headquarters of Siwan district in western Bihar, close to the Uttar Pradesh border. It is a regional market town on the Barauni-Gorakhpur rail line; Zeeradei, birthplace of India's first President Dr. Rajendra Prasad, lies in Siwan district.

travel.airport: Patna Airport, the nearest major airport (~140 km); distance approximate
travel.railway: Siwan Junction, on the Barauni-Gorakhpur line, in the town
travel.road: NH-531 and SH-73 serve Siwan; local auto-rickshaws and taxis in town

visitor_information.best_time: October-March; Navratri and Durga Puja are the busiest periods
